test_dataset_visualization: run the TestDatasetVisualize test suite to visualize point clouds rendered from Implicitron dataset sequences
render_point_cloud_pytorch3d: create a rendered image from a point cloud and cameras using render_point_cloud_pytorch3d with configurable point radius and topk
get_implicitron_sequence_pointcloud: build a point cloud from an Implicitron dataset sequence using get_implicitron_sequence_pointcloud with mask points and max frames options
change_annotations_to_new_ndc: refactor dataset frame annotations to use ndc_isotropic intrinsics format with isotropic focal length via _change_annotations_to_new_ndc
plot_scene_with_plotly: create an interactive Plotly scene visualization of cameras and point clouds using plot_scene with configurable camera scale and marker size
